components.name: Powerhouse Assurance Layer
components.authority: GitHub current main plus GitHub Actions readback
components.data_contract: Consumes machine-readable assurance manifests and existing evidence references; creates no parallel business-data authority.
components.security_contract: Read-only repository/runtime evidence validation; no secret values stored in manifests; fail-closed on missing coverage.
components.observability_contract: GitHub Actions check result plus deterministic JSON report.
components.cost_capacity_contract: Static deterministic validation; bounded to repository inventory; no paid provider calls.
components.evidence_contract: Merged SHA, successful Powerhouse Assurance workflow, repository readback and Notion writeback.
components.learning_contract: Failures become deduplicated open obligations and feed existing Powerhouse learning/error lineage.

components.name: Portal V2 canonical customer surface
components.authority: GitHub current main + Netlify production readback + Supabase/Powerhouse data authority
components.data_contract: Portal is a dynamic view on canonical Powerhouse data; user input writes back to the same Powerhouse lineage.
components.security_contract: Authenticated customer context, tenant isolation, identity and permission gates fail closed.
components.observability_contract: Portal parity tests, production URL readback and runtime-event evidence.
components.cost_capacity_contract: Uses existing Netlify/Supabase capacity and Powerhouse resource-footprint metering.
components.evidence_contract: Protected legacy baseline + V2 inventory + production route/browser readback.
components.learning_contract: Portal errors, overrides and customer interactions write into existing Powerhouse outcome/learning lineage.

components.name: GitHub workflow fleet
components.data_contract: Workflow state is release evidence; business runtime state remains in Powerhouse/providers.
components.security_contract: Least-privilege workflow permissions; secret values never stored in documentation or manifests.
components.observability_contract: Workflow conclusions, job logs and check-run readback.

recovery_contract.evidence: GitHub rerun/revert via current-main release process

components.cost_capacity_contract: Bounded by GitHub Actions quotas and workflow timeouts.
components.evidence_contract: Successful check run at merged SHA.
components.learning_contract: Failed checks create or update existing Powerhouse obligations; no silent bypass.

components.name: Netlify production function fleet
components.authority: GitHub current main + Netlify production deployment/readback
components.data_contract: Functions may read/write only via existing canonical Powerhouse contracts.
components.security_contract: Server-side secrets only; public routes fail closed for privileged actions.
components.observability_contract: Netlify deployment/function readback plus existing health contracts.

recovery_contract.evidence: Netlify deploy rollback + Git revert runbook

components.cost_capacity_contract: Covered by Powerhouse resource-footprint and provider quota monitoring.
test_contract: existing function-specific tests and production proof workflows
components.evidence_contract: Netlify deployed SHA and function-specific provider/HTTP readback.
components.learning_contract: Failures and outcomes feed existing Powerhouse error/learning lineage.

components.name: Supabase Edge Function fleet
components.authority: GitHub current main migrations/functions + Supabase production runtime
components.data_contract: Canonical tenant-aware Powerhouse schema, provenance and lineage contracts.
components.security_contract: RLS/service-role boundaries, authenticated privileged execution and explicit grants.
components.observability_contract: Function invocation/readback, database health and scheduled runtime evidence.

recovery_contract.evidence: Git migration/function rollback and Supabase recovery process

components.cost_capacity_contract: Covered by Powerhouse resource-footprint, token/provider and database capacity monitoring.
components.evidence_contract: Production schema/function readback and runtime event evidence.
components.learning_contract: Runtime failures and observed outcomes feed existing Powerhouse learning/calibration lineage.
